06-github-viewer-cli — the project root: the brain (`rgh.rut`) is the
entry module, and the std closure mixes the two dep kinds the engine
allows over a CDN artifact.

THE CDN ROW: `http` ships as a COMMITTED v7 compiled bundle
(dist/std/http.rutbundle, jsDelivr-served at the tag, sha256-pinned
here — the pin is law at the mount door on every load). Its classes
are CONCRETE — the methods cross on the surface's inherent rows — and
its whole closure (http_host, strbuild, strbuild_host) rides inside.

THE PATH ROWS: pouch, nmapset, json and async_host are GENERIC
owners, and since the generic-source riding law their bundles would
serve this app's consumer-spelled shapes at the link — the path rows
are a CHOICE, not a wall: the tree checkout is this example's
hermetic test input (the fixture lane mounts them from the tree, the
url lane seeds http only). See docs/src/reference/bundles.md (the
std-CDN section).

THE APP'S OWN HOST PKG: `rgh_host` (this project's CLI-I/O rows) is
a decl surface — the brain imports it, so the manifest names it. Its
bodies live in the embedding Rust half (src/main.rs), so `rut run`
stops at the boot door ("declared but never bound"): the generic CLI
registry carries no rgh_host bodies by design — the embedder binds
them (`install_host_pkg` over the mounted rows).
